tasks.label: Generate pdf from tex
tasks.command: mkdir -p out && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=out -interaction=nonstopmode cycles-through-1-qn1.tex && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=out -interaction=nonstopmode cycles-through-1-qn1.tex && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=out -interaction=nonstopmode fixed-start-qn1.tex && /Library/TeX/texbin/lualatex -output-directory=out -interaction=nonstopmode fixed-start-qn1.tex && open out/cycles-through-1-qn1.pdf out/fixed-start-qn1.pdf
